rules: This register describes sources; it does not activate anything. The knowledge base reads knowledge_base/CL_source_manifest.json and CL_collected_lock.json, which this file does not replace.
Existing versions keep kb_status 'candidate' until a named reviewer approves them (D3).
Researched sources are listed under candidates[] with activated: false and kb_status 'not_ingested'.
Every date is YYYY-MM-DD or null, with its evidence. Missing metadata stays null; it is never guessed.

Evidence levels: observed (page or file opened, date given), observed_listing_only (seen as a listing entry or link; the document itself not opened), observed_in_file (read from a captured or opened file), snippet_only (search result text, page not opened), supplied (given by the founder), unresolved.

discovery_status 'discovered' means only that a tool saw the document or link. It is not verified (a person checked it) and not approved (a named reviewer, D3). Nothing discovered is collected or activated without the founder's approval.

gaps.what: Deregistration deadline conflict: ER Art. 14(1) says 20 business days (all 3 captured versions); the FTA deregistration service page says 30 business days (page updated 2026-09-24)
gaps.rule: the agent must not state a deregistration deadline until resolved
gaps.finding: Not an extraction error (raw PDF text reads '20 (twenty) Business Days' in all 3 ER files). Not an English-web translation slip (the FTA Arabic page also says 30). No amendment found that changes ER Art. 14(1): VATP040 lists CD 100/2024 changes to Art. 14(4), 14(5), 14(9) only; ER@v3 consolidates up to CD 149/2026 and still says 20. Cause unresolved.
gaps.finding_v1_3_0: Arabic ER (consolidated to CD 149/2026, p. 10) also says 20 working days: not a translation error in the regulation. Only the FTA service page says 30. Status BLOCKED pending reviewer (D3).
gaps.finding_v1_6_0: Landscape research 2026-10-17: the Tax Procedures ER (CD 74/2023 as amended by CD 17/2026) sets no deregistration deadline; the FTA tax-group deregistration page says 20 business days; only the FTA VAT deregistration service page says 30 (the same page gives 30 business days as FTA processing time). Research opinion: 20 business days is the legal rule. Status stays BLOCKED until a qualified reviewer decides (D3).
gaps.update_2026_10_17: Portal ER (UAELEG-ER-1226, last update 01 Sep 2026) Art. 14(1) also says 20 working days; the FTA service page still says 30 (Firecrawl 2026-10-17, both runs). Still blocked for the reviewer; enquiry drafted, not sent.

gaps.what: ER Article 1 (Definitions) has no passage of its own in any ER version (heading merged into 'Front matter')
FTA-VAT-DL8@v1 is outdated: does not include DL 16/2025 (effective 2026-01-01); the newer consolidated copy is not located
gaps.owner: founder (locate by hand) then approved collection
gaps.update_2026_10_17: Current consolidated text located on the official portal (UAELEG-DL8-2017, includes DL 16/2025). Not collected (needs D13) and not approved (D3); FTA-VAT-DL8@v1 stays outdated, so G3 stays open.

gaps.what: No official Arabic original or official-portal text collected; MOJ eLaws unreachable; uaelegislation.gov.ae blocked to the tools
Reuse terms: FTA terms require prior written consent for copying beyond personal/non-commercial/educational use; EmaraTax manuals marked Private and Confidential
4 HTML captures in data/raw/FTA-VAT-REG-PAGE/ are not in the lock; the registration page returns different bytes on each fetch, so raw hashes cannot detect content change for web pages
Official texts and issue dates of DL 16/2025, CD 100/2025 and CD 149/2026 not located
gaps.note_v1_4_0: CD 149/2026 MoF PDF URL found via search but returned 404 on 2026-10-16 (candidate MOF-CD149-2026-TEXT).
gaps.update_2026_10_17: Portal modification history of DL 8/2017 lists amendments in 2022, 2024 and 2025 (DL 16/2025 corroborated); last-update dates recorded. Separate official texts of CD 100/2025 and CD 149/2026 still not located (a 2-credit portal search found nothing).

gaps.what: Footnote lines (amendment notes, including future-effective text for ER Art. 55 from 2027) sit inside article passages, sometimes in the wrong article (QA E1/C07).
No official Arabic text in the knowledge base; English copies are self-described unofficial translations (QA A1/A2).
